info.title: Flurit
info.description: Customer-retention intelligence platform for B2B SaaS (Predict -> Explain -> Prioritize)

post.summary: Score canonical feature vector for customer churn risk
post.description:
Score a point-in-time canonical customer feature payload.

Computes uncalibrated model churn score and assigns risk tier using the
frozen Logistic Regression champion pipeline. Scoped to authorized tenant workspace.

post.summary: Predict customer churn score, SHAP explanation factors, and segment assignment
post.description:
Generate comprehensive customer risk assessment scoped to authorized workspace.

Includes uncalibrated churn score, local additive SHAP factor contributions (raising
vs mitigating risk), and unsupervised K-Means behavioral segment assignment.
Rejects cross-workspace account queries with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

post.summary: Group scored customer accounts into Value x Risk priority quadrants
post.description:
Prioritize a portfolio of scored customer accounts into Value x Risk quadrants.

Calculates Estimated Revenue at Risk (MRR * score) and aggregates accounts into 5
actionable priority tiers. Note: Revenue at risk is an operational prioritization
estimate, NOT a guaranteed financial loss or calibrated probability.

post.summary: Upload and profile customer CSV datasets
post.description:
Upload one or more CSV files, parse them safely, and generate structural & statistical profiles.

Inspects column data types, missing value percentages, duplicate rows, candidate
primary/foreign keys, date ranges, and candidate churn targets. Requires authorized workspace.

post.summary: Validate concept schema mapping and assess dataset readiness
post.description:
Validate user-defined column mappings against Flurit's core SaaS entities.

Evaluates:
  1. Mandatory relational keys, timestamps, and column existence.
  2. Temporal observation span for 60-day churn target construction.
  3. Coverage across all 45 canonical features and compatibility with the frozen model.

Returns mapping preview, validation issues, recommendations, and overall readiness
status (READY, PARTIALLY_READY, or UNSUPPORTED). Requires authorized workspace.

post.summary: Preview custom dataset transformation and execution readiness
post.description:
Validate schema mapping and preview execution without running heavy ML scoring.

Performs referential integrity validation, checks temporal spans, and estimates
point-in-time snapshot eligibility and readiness flags. Scoped to authorized workspace.

post.summary: Execute end-to-end custom dataset processing, snapshotting, and ML analysis (Synchronous)
post.description:
Execute complete end-to-end processing pipeline on uploaded customer datasets.

Performs:
  1. Relational validation & canonical intermediate transformation.
  2. Point-in-time snapshot generation & leak-free 60-day target labeling.
  3. Canonical 45-feature extraction across mapped domains.
  4. Scoring, SHAP factor attribution, K-Means segmentation, and Value x Risk prioritization
     (for compatible datasets).
Scoped to authorized tenant workspace.

Note:
  This synchronous endpoint is retained for backwards compatibility. For production datasets,
  prefer the asynchronous POST /onboarding/process/async endpoint.

post.summary: Enqueue asynchronous custom dataset processing job (alias)
post.description:
Submit CSV datasets and schema mapping for background asynchronous processing.

Accepts datasets, persists them safely in partitioned temporary storage, registers
a tracking record in `processing_jobs`, and dispatches execution to the background queue.
Returns HTTP 202 Accepted with a unique job ID immediately. Scoped to authorized workspace.

get.summary: List dataset processing jobs for authorized workspace
get.description: List recent dataset processing jobs scoped strictly to caller's authorized workspace.

post.summary: Enqueue asynchronous custom dataset processing and ML analysis
post.description:
Submit CSV datasets and schema mapping for background asynchronous processing.

Accepts datasets, persists them safely in partitioned temporary storage, registers
a tracking record in `processing_jobs`, and dispatches execution to the background queue.
Returns HTTP 202 Accepted with a unique job ID immediately. Scoped to authorized workspace.

get.summary: Get processing job status, progress, and results
get.description:
Retrieve execution status, percentage progress, stage notes, and results for a job.

Enforces strict workspace tenant isolation: foreign workspace job lookups return HTTP 403.

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running processing job
post.description: Cancel an active processing job and release staged files. Scoped to authorized workspace.
